battleFormations.name: Lords of Dread
battleFormations.effect: Tyrannical Court: +2 Objective Control for CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER models. Once per battle round, if your Warlord is on the battlefield, use the Claimed for the Dark Gods Stratagem for 0CP.

battleFormations.name: Traitoris Lance
battleFormations.effect: Paragons of Terror: At the start of the first battle round, after selecting Dread abilities normally, select one additional Dread ability for your army (cannot be randomly selected).

battleFormations.name: Infernal Lance
battleFormations.effect: Malefic Surge: In your Command phase, units can make a Malefic Surge (Leadership test, fail = D3 mortal wounds) to become Empowered until your next Command phase, then use one of: Unholy Hunger (+3" Move), Diabolic Power ([LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]), or Unnatural Fortitude (5+ invuln or Feel No Pain 6+).

battleFormations.name: Houndpack Lance
battleFormations.effect: Marked Prey: Select an enemy unit each Command phase; WAR DOG attacks against it gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] if visible. Requires 3+ WAR DOG units; they gain BATTLELINE; select 3 WAR DOG units to gain the CHARACTER keyword for the battle.

artefacts.name: Nightmare's Master
artefacts.effect: [CHAOS KNIGHTS model only] At the start of the Fight phase, enemy units within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.

artefacts.name: Tyrant's Shadow
artefacts.effect: [CHAOS KNIGHTS model only] At the end of your Command phase, secure a controlled objective near the bearer; while held, that objective has the Deathly Terror ability.

artefacts.name: Malevolent
artefacts.effect: Enhancement named in source notes — exact rules text/cost not confirmed; check codex/Wahapedia.

artefacts.name: Malevolent Heraldry
artefacts.effect: [CHAOS KNIGHTS model only] Re-roll one or both dice when randomly selecting Dread abilities, if the bearer is on the battlefield.

artefacts.name: Veil of Medrengard
artefacts.effect: [CHAOS KNIGHTS model only] The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks and 5+ against melee attacks.

artefacts.name: Knight Diabolus
artefacts.effect: [CHAOS KNIGHTS model only] +1 Weapon Skill; melee weapons gain [LANCE] while using Diabolic Power.

artefacts.name: Blasphemous Engine
artefacts.effect: [CHAOS KNIGHTS model only] +2 Wounds; re-roll the Leadership test taken during Malefic Surge.

artefacts.name: Fleshmetal Fusion
artefacts.effect: [CHAOS KNIGHTS model only] +1 Toughness; while using Unnatural Fortitude, add 1 to armour saves against Damage-1 attacks.

artefacts.name: Bestial Aspect
artefacts.effect: [CHAOS KNIGHTS model only] Ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT]; while using Unholy Hunger, ignore Move/Advance modifiers.

artefacts.name: Throne Mechanicum of Skulls
artefacts.effect: [CHAOS KNIGHTS model only] Re-roll Charge rolls; once per battle, eligible to charge in a turn it Advanced.

artefacts.name: Blade of Celerity
artefacts.effect: [CHAOS KNIGHTS model only] Ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT]; once per battle, the bearer's unit gains Fights First.

artefacts.name: Warp-borne Stalker
artefacts.effect: [CHAOS KNIGHTS model only] The bearer has Deep Strike; once per battle, if unengaged at the end of the opponent's turn, retreat to Strategic Reserves.

artefacts.name: Putrid Carapace
artefacts.effect: [CHAOS KNIGHTS model only] Save characteristic of 2+; once per battle, regain up to D6 wounds at the start of a Command phase.

artefacts.name: Mirror of Fates
artefacts.effect: [CHAOS KNIGHTS model only] Once per turn, increase the CP cost of an opponent's Stratagem targeting a unit within 12" by 1CP.

artefacts.name: Blessing of the Dark Master
artefacts.effect: [CHAOS KNIGHTS model only] The bearer has Stealth; once per battle, change a saving throw's Damage to 0.

artefacts.name: Preyslayer's Mantle
artefacts.effect: [WAR DOG model only] The bearer gains the Super-heavy Walker ability.

artefacts.name: Final Howl
artefacts.effect: [WAR DOG model only] Aura: nearby friendly War Dogs re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

artefacts.name: Loping Predator
artefacts.effect: [WAR DOG model only] The bearer's ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT].

artefacts.name: Panoply of the Cursed Knight
artefacts.effect: [WAR DOG model only] Attacks against the bearer worsen Armour Penetration by 1.

armyRules.name: Harbingers of Dread
armyRules.effect: Deathly Terror (Aura, always active): enemy units within 9" have Leadership worsened by 1. At the start of battle rounds 1, 3, and 5, select or randomly roll two additional Dread abilities from: Despair (further -1 LD aura, cumulative), Doom (+1 Wound vs Battle-shocked targets), Darkness (Stealth), Dismay (aura forces Battle-shock tests on below-strength units), Delirium (aura inflicts D3 mortal wounds on failed Battle-shock for Below Half-strength units), Dominion (+3" aura range). Selected abilities last the rest of the battle; cannot repeat one.

armyRules.name: Dreadblades
armyRules.effect: If every model in your army has the CHAOS keyword, you can include 1 TITANIC Chaos Knights model or up to 3 WAR DOG models regardless of Faction keyword. Cannot be Warlord, cannot receive Enhancements.

armyRules.name: Super-heavy Walker
armyRules.effect: As per Imperial Knights: move through non-TITANIC models/terrain 4" or less in height (can move within, not end within, Engagement Range); taller terrain risks Battle-shock on a D6 roll of 1.

sourceNotes: Detachment rules/Enhancements verified against Wahapedia wh40k11ed where marked; entries carried over from prior data are unverified placeholders pending confirmation. Removed "Nightmare's Master" from detachments list: it is an Artefact (under Houndpack Lance), not a Detachment.
